newsitem.title: USA: Resource Bancshares to spin off subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Resource Bancshares to spin off subsidiary.

text.p: Resource Bancshares Corp., which markets financial services, said Tuesday it plans to spin off Republic Services Co. Inc., its subsidiary specialising in electronic commerce processing, in the fourth quarter.
In the past six years, Republic Services has mailed over 100 million credit card and other solicitations.

Columbia, S.C.-based Resource said the spin-off should allow the parent to "expand into non-traditional areas of electronic commerce, including the Internet," and better position it "to pursue acquisitions or other opportunities that may arise."
Resource's businesses also include risk analysis, customer service, security, credit, collections, management information and telemarketing.
Resource's stock was unchanged at $13 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
